steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Recon complete. No hostiles sighted.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The route map they gave us sure is nifty. We actually managed to get here first without any real obstacles along the way.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: All the tech used in the new city's design comes from Columbia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It has lots of functionality that none of the mafiosi ever understood.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: For example, the road leading directly to the control tower will be blocked off after we pass through.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They've also managed to block other intersections with various methods.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Not to mention, what we saw along the way.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The conflicts between the famiglie have been spreading. At this point, even if any of them wanted to attack the control tower, another famiglia would get in the way.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Most importantly, they'd never expect us to take it from right under their noses.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's right. However, it's too soon to rest on our laurels.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The Bellones, Rossatis, and Saluzzos. Those three famiglie will never give up the secondary core area. They will definitely make an appearance.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: With me and Texas here, you've got nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Sorry, I wasn't trying to get you dragged into this mess.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I chose to do this.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Same here! And in exchange, I'll need you to tell me where I can get the best pizza!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Deal.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You said the tech here comes from Columbia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's right. Famiglia Rossati laid most of the groundwork, so I'm a little concerned they'll have some way of breaking through.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If there's one place they have no choice but to pass through, where would that be?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Something's not right here.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You feel it too?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: It has something to do with the other famiglie getting in the way, but...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: While it's possible that big gate over there might've been activated accidentally...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: We've been taking detours for a while now, and I'm pretty sure these blockades were set here on purpose.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: In other words... someone's one step ahead of us?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Yes, and they also happen to be very familiar with the area.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And only the Rossatis fit that bill.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The only other possibility would be those who helped in the conversion of the secondary core area.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Let's not worry about who it could be for now.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: How do we break through?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I can give it a try. One of my soldiers should know how.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We're wasting too much time.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: And...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: If someone really set this up on purpose, they'll definitely have a backup plan.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I know what you're going to say.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Even though we haven't had the most fun partnering here, we're about to the part where our agreement formally ends.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Guess so.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You know, in a sense, we're brothers in misfortune.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We have nothing in common.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Am I wrong though?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I can already tell that you're a guy with a smart look to him, but you're actually a complete idiot, loyal to a fault. Same as me.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Don't bother trying to talk yourself up like that. Nobody's buying it.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'm not looking for excuses here. I know what I'm doing, and I don't regret it.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But if what you said is true and your boss was the one who set all of this in motion, you're probably gonna find yourself standing against your own fratelli.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Are you prepared to do what you've gotta do?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Will you really get what you're looking for?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: How about you? Did you get what you were looking for?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: No, I've got a guilty conscience, but there's nothing I can do about it.

steps.name: Bailiff
steps.text: Your Honor, I found the control tower technicians hiding in one of the rooms.

steps.name: Bailiff
steps.text: They want to talk to you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Deal.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: You're... a judge?!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm not here to hurt you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm not here on behalf of any famiglia, or Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: Then who are you here for?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Right now, no one.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: As long as you don't hurt us, we should be able to help you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I want to ask you something first.

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Who told you to start the separation sequence of the secondary core area? Was it a mafioso from Famiglia Bellone?

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: He said he was the don of Famiglia Bellone, Bernardo.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It really was you... Bernardo.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Did you have to do this all for the sake of your so-called power?

steps.name: Calm Technician
steps.text: He also asked me if I had ever imagined what Siracusa would look like without famiglie.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What did you say...?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Up ahead is the central facility that controls that gate, isn't it?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Life keeps bringing us together, doesn't it? Cellinia.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: That's right. Only one of us can walk out of this alive.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Lavinia...? The judge?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: We followed your instructions and not to break through right away. We took some detours and nabbed ourselves a government guy. That's what he told us.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: She's already taken the control tower.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I have to admit, no famiglia would've thought such an insignificant judge could pull off something like that with just a few paper pushers.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But, even if she managed to stall those famiglie with her funny business, what good will it do, in the end?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Boss, bad news!

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Out with it.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: It's Lappland! She suddenly showed up at the estate and started chopping up our boys! She's making her way over to you!

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Stop her.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Lappland, you sure have gotten good at killing.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Back in the day, you would've taken a lot longer and picked up a few more scars on your way here.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You haven't changed at all. You don't even bat an eye at your own boys getting killed.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: What's the point in crying over some incompetent associates?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What about an incompetent child? Oh, spiacente, I almost forgot that for you, there's no basically difference between an associate and your own child.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You know what I hate more than anything else, ragazza? Incompetent idiots who are also obedient.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I've been waiting a long time for you, ever since you came back home.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Waiting for you to bare your fangs at me.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And now, that time has finally come.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Tell me, figlia mia. All these years, what is it that has made you like this? What made you disobey me, rebel against me time and time again?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Speak up, so I can discipline you.
Upon hearing Alberto's words, Lappland cracks a smile.
However, she lowers the weapons in her hands.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: For the longest time, I've been thinking if I should try rubbing you out.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Surely, killing your own father isn't something that would give you a moment's hesitation.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's not the act that I'm conflicted over, more the meaning of it.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: The meaning? A woman like you cares to go searching for meaning in things?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Meaning is pretty important to me. Like profit is to you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Padre mio, do you know why I care so much about Texas?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You've never explained it to me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: From the moment I was born, I grew up a part of this famiglia.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You raised me with the most proper Siracusan education, and I met your expectations.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: As a Siracusan, I am second to none.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And here I thought you never acknowledged who you were, ragazza.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: When do you think I managed to wiggle out of your control?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or I guess, not from your control, but from Siracusa. From the famiglia. From our blood. From the control of our rules.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I hated it, all of it. But in the end, I couldn't actually escape any of it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: All those things are like the strings of a marionette over my head.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No matter how much I rebelled, in the end, I'm still dancing in the palm of your hand.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There's no way out.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Only you would look at Siracusa and see an inescapable swamp.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And everybody—including you, padre—you're all scum, whether you realize it or not.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Of course, I didn't realize it, at that age.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The old me thought she was crazy enough, rebellious enough. But looking back, I was just in denial.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And you thought I'd grow out of it after a few years. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: That goes without saying.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I was well aware of your rebelliousness, but I never understood where it came from.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: From you being so totally convinced that your way of life, and your actions, were completely right.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You never doubted for a second that I would eventually become you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And that's... when she appeared.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: At first, it was because there was someone out there, in far-off Columbia, who was better than me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Cellinia Texas, the granddaughter of Salvadore.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Cold. Strong. Honorable and loyal.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: After popping back over here, she quickly became the most famous Siracusan among all the famiglie.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Even though she was Columbian.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You're just as good as her.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hah, of course.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But that's not the important part.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The important part is, she clearly was a Siracusan, thoroughly poisoned by the swamp of this city.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But in the end, she chose to turn her back on her blood, letting her entire famiglia get liquidated.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: The blame for that rests only with Giuseppe. Where is Cellinia's sin in the righteous judgment of her kin?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Not like betrayal is particularly rare among wolves.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But she chose to turn her back. She chose to get out.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Can you imagine, padre?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That day, when I found out she wanted to leave Siracusa, to leave everything behind, I was so...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Exhilarated!

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You figured it was an act of rebellion, and a successful one?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: She didn't succeed. I knew from the beginning that the land itself wasn't going to let her go.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: So, why are you standing here in front of me again, for her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: For her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No, padre mio. No.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm here not because I learned anything in particular from her successes and failures.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But because she taught me that the choice exists in the first place.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I knew she would eventually return here. And I looked forward to seeing what she would do once she came back.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And she did absolutely nothing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No. You don't understand.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: She made up her mind.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Cellinia, what do you think you're doing?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You don't need to know. And you're not going to.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You ran away from Columbia before, and from Siracusa. You ran from it all.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And now, you have the stones to stand on this soil again.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Isn't that kind of ridiculous?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This land isn't a lost cause.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So, I'm not running away anymore. Simple as that.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You stopped running, so you came back.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But what about the people you left behind?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Go tell that to them!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Blame it all on me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You decided you had to kill Giovanna, so you pinned the blame on me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'm not that shameless yet.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But, you will pay for it all the same.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You're gonna have to die, Cellinia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Don't worry, death is where I belong.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Damn... you...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Now, it's my turn.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: This used to keep me up at night.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But when I finally stood in front of you, face-to-face, I realized—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: This was never such a difficult thing in the first place.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Turns out, it's not that I wanted to rebel against you, or kill you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: All I need to do is say goodbye. To you, my dear father, to this famiglia, to this swamp.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's why I'm here.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You want to become an enemy to all of Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Siracusa became my enemy.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Goodbye forever, padre.
Lappland gives her father a deep parting bow.
A vague thought creeps across Alberto's mind—this is his best chance to be rid of this monster.
That's right. Monster.
A monster he raised with his own two hands.
She is by no means invincible, but it seems like nothing is capable of touching her.
He is a hundred percent sure that if he strikes now, he would be able to slay his daughter on the spot.
She is by no means dauntless, yet she chose to throw away everything she had to throw away.
He knows he should act now, to rid himself of future headaches.
But...
'Padre.'
She is a monster. And yet, one that he raised with his own two hands.
If all she wanted was simple freedom, why would she still come to see him?
Lone wolves eventually remember the pack to which they belonged. But after today, his daughter will no longer belong to any pack.
Alberto lets out a heavy sigh.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: The next time I see you, I will kill you. My daughter. My pride. My traitor.

spans.text: The next time I see you, I
kill you. My daughter. My pride. My traitor.

steps.text: Lappland smiles, but does not answer.
She is no longer a lone wolf.
Never again will Siracusa have a place for her.
And never again will she need one.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The only thing left is you, Texas.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Are you sure letting Cellinia go alone was the right call?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Don't sweat it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: She asked to go herself, so she must've had a reason for it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You don't want to find out what that reason is?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Lemme give you a little tip. One of the prerequisites for being a good partner is to never ask your counterpart about stuff she doesn't wanna share!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You two have a great relationship.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You betcha!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You've got somebody coming up on you. He's moving really fast.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Just one?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah, just one.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Black hair, dressed like a really flamboyant mob boss, holding two pistol-shaped wands.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Leon?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia... I knew it'd be you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leontuzzo, why did you come here?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm looking for you. But you cut all communication with the famiglia, so I haven't been able to get through.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: While I was looking around, I overheard wise guys from another famiglia talking about how someone had blocked off some passages in the secondary core area, which didn't sound like something any of us would do.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Which is why I came here.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's right... You were with Carracci so long, you must've known this was the best place to break through.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But, I have nothing more to say to you, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Wait, Lavinia...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm here to—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon?! Lavinia, and the court guys too...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Alright, so you're the one who's been messing around with the secondary core area behind our backs.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon, where the hell did you go after that meeting? Don't tell me you've been with her this whole time.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: No, I went looking for my father.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Why didn't you tell me?!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Because when I was face-to-face with Alberto, when I heard the things that carwash worker had to say about me, I finally realized—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I've been wrong my entire life.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's why...
Demetri and Lavinia stand on opposite sides of the wide avenue.
Leontuzzo takes a deep breath, and finally walks over to Lavinia's side.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: That's your answer, huh?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: From now on, I am no longer Don Bellone.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon... you know what this means, don't you?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Do you?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: No matter how grand the Don's ideals were, he still chose to abandon his famiglia!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: And you, no matter how grand your ideals may be, you're gonna do the same?!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We're a famiglia, goddammit, Leontuzzo!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Look me in the eye and answer me!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We grew up together. We've been through so much together.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Does all of that mean nothing to you?!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: My father saw the famiglia as nothing more than a match to light the fuse of a new era in Siracusa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: He was wrong in his ways, but...
Leontuzzo gradually raises his eyes and looks directly at Demetri.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In the end, I'll stand against all famiglie.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Since it's bound to happen sooner or later—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Let's not drag out the suffering, Demetri.
Just when everything is about to teeter over the edge, a chill engulfs everyone present.

a.text: Not even your bones will remain.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What... is this...?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Urgh... There's a voice... in my head...
A black fog congeals around the area.
As the fog condenses, an impalpable coercion gradually presses down on the heads, shoulders, and hearts gathered there.
From this coercion they feel a thread of kinship, as if its very existence is entangled with the blood in their veins. No, it is indeed an existence entangled with their blood.
But the thread immediately snaps, leaving only bottomless fear behind. Because within this coercion broils bottomless anger.
In this moment, all reason is suppressed, as if a voice is screaming out to them—
Bow down.
Surrender.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: It's freezing cold...
Those unable to bear the pressure fall one by one, until only Leontuzzo, Lavinia, and Demetri remain standing.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I remember this feeling...
Leontuzzo turns his gaze towards the entity emerging from the coalesced fog—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Watch out, there's something off about that stuff!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: ...Il Signore dei Lupi.
Before the words leave his lips, a pack of wolves formed from the fog lunges at Leontuzzo and the others.
